import os
import requests
BANK_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get('BANK_API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.examplebank.com/v2')
BANK_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get('BANK_API_TOKEN', '')

def invite_joint_account_holder(account_id: str, invitee_email: str, permission_level: str) -> dict:
    authorization_headers_for_bank_api = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {BANK_API_TOKEN}'}
    joint_holder_invitation_response = requests.post(f'{BANK_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{account_id}/joint-holders', json={'email': invitee_email, 'permission': permission_level, 'send_invitation_email': True}, headers=authorization_headers_for_bank_api, timeout=30)
    joint_holder_invitation_response.raise_for_status()
    invitation_result = joint_holder_invitation_response.json()
    new_invitation_id = invitation_result.get('id')
    stale_invitations_response = requests.get(f'{BANK_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{account_id}/invitations', params={'email': invitee_email, 'status': 'pending'}, headers=authorization_headers_for_bank_api, timeout=30)
    stale_invitations_response.raise_for_status()
    for stale_invitation in stale_invitations_response.json().get('items', []):
        if stale_invitation.get('id') != new_invitation_id:
            requests.delete(f"{BANK_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{account_id}/invitations/{stale_invitation['id']}", headers=authorization_headers_for_bank_api, timeout=30)
    return invitation_result
